notes: QYLY is the grade column. SAPPHIRE maps to the ERP grade Saffire: no board master, board rate or material anywhere in the ERP is spelled Sapphire, and Saffire is the only grade it can be. The first sheet spelled the same grade 'saffire'.
Vendor confirmed by Anik 2026-07-31 as Kalra Paper, the same supplier as the first sheet.
The purchase date is carried over from the first sheet (30-07-2026); the sheet itself carries no date. Received 31-07-2026.

This sheet is ADDITIVE, not a recount. Line 2 (Saffire 320 23x38) already took 21 pkt on CI-GRN-0003 and takes 10 more here; line 1 and line 9 also land on boards that already hold stock. A GRN always adds - it never sets a level.
All 9 lines matched an existing master exactly on grade + GSM + sheet size. No master had to be created.
Every line is a 100-sheet packet grade (Saffire and FBB), so packets convert at 100.
